latest.title: Cómo Identificar y Documentar la Infraestructura y Arquitectura de un Sistema
latest.description: La identificación de la arquitectura existente de un sistema es un proceso fundamental para comprender cómo está estructurado un sistema, cómo interactúan sus componentes y qué capacidades posee. Este análisis permite obtener una visión clara y detallada del estado actual del sistema, lo cual es esencial para cualquier proceso de migración, actualización o mejora. Además, facilita la toma de decisiones informadas sobre la infraestructura y las tecnologías necesarias para soportar las operaciones.

latest.title: Security Measures for Amazon Bedrock's 'Monitor model invocation'
latest.description:
I've had more opportunities to develop generative AI applications on Amazon Bedrock and to run Claude Code via Bedrock. During that work, 
I had enabled Amazon Bedrock's "Monitor model invocation" feature somewhat casually, just to get started. However, when I actually looked at the logs, 
I realized that information that really shouldn't be stored on a server — such as Monitor model invocation (PII) — was being saved.
In response, I reconsidered the security settings for "Monitor model invocation."

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
